items.exampleEn: We grow tomatoes and herbs on our terrace.
items.exampleZh: 我們在露台上種番茄和香草。

items.exampleEn: Visitors must leave their belongings at the front desk before entering.
items.exampleZh: 參觀者進場前必須把隨身物品寄放在服務台。

items.exampleEn: They rented a small villa by the sea for the summer.
items.exampleZh: 他們夏天在海邊租了一棟小別墅。

items.exampleEn: Attending the safety training is compulsory for all new workers.
items.exampleZh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。

items.exampleEn: The landlady raised our rent by five percent.
items.exampleZh: 女房東把我們的房租調高了百分之五。

items.exampleEn: Real estate prices in the city center keep rising.
items.exampleZh: 市中心的房地產價格持續上漲。

items.sentenceEn: Please take all your belongings with you when you leave the train.
items.sentenceZh: 下車時請帶走您所有的隨身物品。

items.audioEn: Our landlady said we can paint the walls, but we must not put nails in them.
items.audioZh: 我們的女房東說我們可以粉刷牆壁，但不能在牆上釘釘子。
items.questionZh: 女房東說房客不能做什麼？
options: Make small holes in the walls

items.sentenceEn: We had breakfast on the terrace and watched the sun rise.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在露台上吃早餐，看著太陽升起。

items.sentenceEn: Wearing a helmet is compulsory on this bike path.
items.sentenceZh: 在這條腳踏車道上騎車一定要戴安全帽。

items.stemEn: The thief took all my ____, including my passport and my phone.
items.stemZh: 小偷偷走了我所有的財物，包括我的護照和手機。

items.stemEn: In this school, English is a ____ subject, so every student must take it.
items.stemZh: 在這所學校，英文是必修科目，所以每個學生都必須修。

items.passageEn: Last month, my aunt sold her apartment in the city and moved into an old villa in the hills. A friend who works in real estate helped her find it. The villa has a big terrace with a view of the valley, and my aunt loves drinking tea there. Moving was hard work: it took three days to pack all her belongings. Her landlady from her student days, Mrs. Ota, came to help, and they laughed about the tiny room my aunt had rented forty years ago. In her new neighborhood, sorting trash is compulsory, so my aunt now does it carefully. Her son works in health care at the nearby hospital, so he visits every weekend.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我阿姨賣掉了城裡的公寓，搬進山上一棟老別墅。一位從事房地產工作的朋友幫她找到這棟房子。別墅有一個可以眺望山谷的大露台，阿姨很喜歡在那裡喝茶。搬家很辛苦：她花了三天才把所有物品打包好。她學生時代的女房東 Ota 太太也來幫忙，兩人笑談阿姨四十年前租的那間小房間。在她的新社區，垃圾分類是強制的，所以阿姨現在都很仔細地分類。她兒子在附近的醫院從事醫療照護工作，所以每個週末都會來看她。

options: 在房地產公司上班的朋友

items.promptZh: 他在一家房地產公司工作了十年。
referenceEn: He worked for a real estate company for ten years.
He has worked at a real estate company for ten years.
rubricZh: 「房地產公司」可寫，例如 a real estate company、a real estate agency 等
時態配合內容（例如 worked、has worked 等）

items.promptZh: 我的女房東住在樓上，還養了兩隻貓。
referenceEn: My landlady lives upstairs and has two cats.
My landlady lives on the floor above me, and she has two cats.
rubricZh: 「女房東」可寫，例如 landlady 等
「住在樓上」可寫，例如 lives upstairs、lives on the floor above me 等
「養了兩隻貓」可寫，例如 has two cats、keeps two cats 等
